scientific_intent.scientific_task: Primordial hydrogen/helium radiative cooling and photoionization heating
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Katz1996 recombination, collisional ionization, excitation, recombination and free-free cooling rates; up to20 electron-density iterations for heat1
scientific_intent.discretization: Independent temperature-grid evaluations, no spatial PDE transport
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: All1024 outputs finite; both heat0/1 rates satisfy1e-34+1e-10relative CPU and dualGPU checks, much stricter than originalabsolute1e-3. Doesnotvalidateastrophysicalmodel against observational data.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Tiny cooling rates require finite-aware relative checks, not original1e-3absolute which dwarfs~1e-26 rates; lowtemperature exponentialunderflow causesundefinedspecies ratios.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Hydrogen/helium cooling source terms in astrophysical gas simulation; nativecomment citesKatz1996, not a complete hydrodynamic integrator.
scientific_intent.description: The complete native primordial-cooling function evaluates equilibrium species and thermal source terms, including every original rate equation and iterative heating branch. The study repairs a historical Julia dummy and selects a finite positive-temperature range while retaining unchanged native mathematics.
scientific_intent.provenance: Native cooling-cuda/main.cu citesKatz etal1996 and defines primordial_cool. No literature coefficients or observational validation added; sourcebacked domainclassification.
